scope: Corridor carry, first training run: 256 environments, each with its own L-shaped corridor (width 1.1-1.5 m, corner 1.2-2.0 m ahead, alternating left/right turns, goal line 1.0 m into the second leg) and a 2-4 kg cabinet (the lift sweep's uncompensated capacity) held by the side-grasp attachment without load feedforward. After a scripted 2.5 s settle and lift under GR00T Balance, PPO chooses the GR00T walk forward speed (0-0.3 m/s; near zero hands over to Balance) and yaw rate (+-0.3 rad/s) every 0.1 s for 300 iterations (~1.8M decisions). A pure-pursuit command (0.2 m/s, yaw rate = bearing of the 1.0 m look-ahead point) is evaluated on the same seeded starts. Speeds other than 0.2 m/s and yaw rates above 0.2 rad/s are untested outside this training.
